correctness.rationale: A proper rook coloring is a Latin rectangle; at each cell odd neighborhood color occurs iff row and column color palettes are unequal. Row clique gives n lower bound and cyclic Z_n matrix attains n for every 1<=m<n. Square n- and n+1-color obstructions follow all-full palettes then equal omitted-frequency argument. Explicit q=n+2 offsets F=Zq\{0,2}, c(i,j)=i+f(j) gives missing pairs separated by cyclic gap 2 in rows and gap 1 in columns, distinct even for q=4; so achieves n+2. New direct finite checking n<=24 supports; frozen artifacts/verify.py explicitly fetched. No dependence on the code for infinite n.
